content: @testcontainers/postgresql's PostgreSqlContainer, started once in Vitest globalSetup, gives a connection string injectable into worker test files; the hybrid isolation pattern seeds schema/fixtures once after container start, then each test wraps its DB work in a transaction that is rolled back in an afterEach — avoiding per-test container startup cost while keeping tests isolated. True per-worker isolation needs one container per Vitest pool worker (globalSetup runs once per worker file in threads/forks pool with singleThread=false).
